title: [SBW] MCSP - ADDON
description: Add-on featuring military vehicle designed in a vanilla-friendly style.
body:
# MCSP Add-On Pack
Game assets are provided by: [![ocp_banner_main](https://i.imgur.com/1DcZswS.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-vehicles-official-content-pack)

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fd057cb44993f04f91c27a73ae578736d98093d.png)
 

**Coremod "\[SBW\] Superb Warfare" is required! \[[Project Link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/superb-warfare)\].**

 

The add-on works in conjunction with the Superb Warfare (SBW) mod.  
It adds infantry fighting vehicles, tanks, and armored vehicles in various camouflages and modifications.  
With their help, you can destroy enemy bases, zombies.. and other players.

The mod is currently in development.

 

**How to install this mod:**

Make sure you have the latest version (0.8.8) of the Superb Warfare mod installed, then simply drop the MCSP mod into the mods folder!

undefined
